name: Polvorones
description: Crumbly Mexican shortbread cookies made with lard and pecans, dusted in powdered sugar and melt-in-the-mouth.
ingredients: a handful of fresh epazote, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pinto beans and ground cumin until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the crumbled cotija cheese with the beef stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 15 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with epazote or a dusting of pickled red onions.
tips: This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
